## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `hardening` — security or robustness improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — code restructuring, no behavior change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD pipeline change
- [ ] `chore` — dependency bump, tooling, cleanup

## Testing

- [ ] `make lint` passes (ruff clean, zero violations)
- [ ] `make test` passes (all tests green)
- [ ] `make verify` passes (compose config valid + smoke test)
- [ ] New behavior covered by at least one new test in `tests/test_gatekeeper.py`

## Documentation

- [ ] `docs/` updated where the change affects architecture, operations, or security
- [ ] `app/policy.yaml` and `app/users.yaml.example` updated if schema changed
- [ ] `.env.example` updated if new environment variables were added (with inline comments)

## Language Compliance

- [ ] All text in code, comments, configs, and docs is in **English** — no other language used anywhere
